description: Defines template classes for control types and local lifetime management within the Thunder::Messaging namespace, including control registration, enabling/disabling, and metadata handling.

classes.name: ControlType
classes.description: Template class managing control state, metadata, and registration for a specific control category and module.

classes.name: LocalLifetimeType
classes.description: Template class providing static methods for managing control lifecycle and metadata for a specific category and module.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the control.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the control is enabled.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Revokes the control registration if enabled.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Static method to announce the control's presence.

methods.name: IsEnabled (static)
methods.description: Checks if the static control is enabled.

methods.name: Enable (static)
methods.description: Enables or disables the static control.

methods.name: Metadata (static)
methods.description: Returns the metadata of the static control.
